tasks.label: Fix project reward values
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command '(Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 "data\projects\small.json" | ConvertFrom-Json) | ForEach-Object { $_.reward = [math]::Round(([double]$_.reward) / 10000); $_ } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 "data\projects\small.json"; (Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 "data\projects\medium.json" | ConvertFrom-Json) | ForEach-Object { $_.reward = [math]::Round(([double]$_.reward) / 10000); $_ } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 "data\projects\medium.json"; (Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 "data\projects\large.json" | ConvertFrom-Json) | ForEach-Object { $_.reward = [math]::Round(([double]$_.reward) / 10000); $_ } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 "data\projects\large.json"'
